mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pcd_directory_closure_table ( ancestor_id, descendant_id, depth, user_id, closure_space_id ) VALUES ( #{nodeId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{nodeId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, 0, #{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} )

INSERT INTO pcd_directory_closure_table ( ancestor_id, descendant_id, depth, user_id, closure_space_id ) SELECT ancestor_id, #{nodeId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, depth + 1, #{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} FROM pcd_directory_closure_table WHERE descendant_id = #{parentId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ((#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} is null and user_id=#{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) OR closure_space_id=#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} OR (#{personalSpace}=true and closure_space_id is null AND user_id=#{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}))
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(depth), 0) FROM pcd_directory_closure_table WHERE descendant_id = #{nodeId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ((#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} is null and user_id=#{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) OR closure_space_id=#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} OR (#{personalSpace}=true and closure_space_id is null AND user_id=#{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}))

SELECT descendant_id FROM pcd_directory_closure_table WHERE ancestor_id = #{ancestorId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ((#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} is null and user_id=#{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) OR closure_space_id=#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} OR (#{personalSpace}=true and closure_space_id is null AND user_id=#{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler})) ORDER BY depth ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE c FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c JOIN ( SELECT descendant_id FROM pcd_directory_closure_table WHERE ancestor_id = #{movingNodeId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ((#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} IS NULL AND user_id = #{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) OR closure_space_id=#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} OR (#{personalSpace}=true AND closure_space_id IS NULL AND user_id=#{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler})) ) subtree ON subtree.descendant_id = c.descendant_id JOIN ( SELECT ancestor_id FROM pcd_directory_closure_table WHERE descendant_id = #{movingNodeId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ((#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} IS NULL AND user_id = #{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) OR closure_space_id=#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} OR (#{personalSpace}=true AND closure_space_id IS NULL AND user_id=#{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler})) AND ancestor_id != #{movingNodeId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} ) old_ancestors ON old_ancestors.ancestor_id = c.ancestor_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pcd_directory_closure_table ( user_id, ancestor_id, descendant_id, depth, closure_space_id ) SELECT supertree.user_id, supertree.ancestor_id, subtree.descendant_id, supertree.depth + subtree.depth + 1, #{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} FROM pcd_directory_closure_table supertree JOIN pcd_directory_closure_table subtree WHERE supertree.descendant_id = #{newParentId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND subtree.ancestor_id = #{movingNodeId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ((#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} is null AND supertree.user_id=#{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND subtree.user_id=#{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) OR (supertree.closure_space_id=#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND subtree.closure_space_id=#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) OR (#{personalSpace}=true AND supertree.closure_space_id IS NULL AND subtree.closure_space_id IS NULL))
mapper.delete: DELETE c FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c JOIN ( SELECT descendant_id FROM pcd_directory_closure_table WHERE ancestor_id = #{rootNodeId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ((#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} IS NULL AND user_id = #{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}) OR closure_space_id=#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} OR (#{personalSpace}=true AND closure_space_id IS NULL AND user_id=#{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler})) ) subtree ON subtree.descendant_id = c.descendant_id
